[]; const message=output.find(x=>x.type==='message'); const part=message?.content?.find(x=>x.type==='output_text'); if (part?.refusal) throw new Error('OpenAI refusal: '+part.refusal); const raw=part?.text; if (!raw) throw new Error('No structured output returned'); let plan; try { plan=JSON.parse(raw); } catch { throw new Error('Malformed structured JSON'); } const required=['briefSummary','audienceInsights','messagingAngles','landingPageOutline','sevenDayContentPlan','assumptions','risks','reviewQuestions','confidence']; if (required.some(k=>plan[k]===undefined) || plan.messagingAngles.length!==3 || plan.sevenDayContentPlan.length!==7) throw new Error('Incomplete campaign plan'); return [{json:{plan}}];
